declared_criteria.C1: the residual read from the executed 555-run receipt has two minimal statements
declared_criteria.C2: a hypothetical situation separates the two statements and is outside the reach of the three fitted machines
declared_criteria.C3: exactly one user verdict collapses the class to one sentence, at the log2(class) price
declared_criteria.C4: the one-bit sentence is FALSIFIED by a real fourth machine: it over-accepts at least one run
declared_criteria.C5: one counterexample question per over-accepted situation conjoins a grounded term and removes every falsifier
declared_criteria.C6: the repaired sentence agrees with every verdict of a fifth machine never used by either intake stage
declared_criteria.C7: the intake refuses with a named cause when no witness exists or the answer is not a verdict
declared_criteria.C8: zero model calls, zero stored parameters, zero network calls at run time

prototype_note: one exploratory run of the one-bit intake was executed while writing the tool and falsified C4; the criteria above were then rewritten so that the falsification is itself a declared, measurable claim

questions.question: Situation: at the start there is one copy of the new content. step 1: nothing changes, so 1 copy remains. Is the goal already achieved in this situation?

fitted_machines.TARBALL: reset never seeds the new content; no delete-then-create history
fitted_machines.FILESYSTEM: reset never seeds the new content
fitted_machines.SQLITE: reset never seeds the new content

questions.question: Situation: at the start there is one copy of the new content. step 1: one new copy appears, so 2 copies remain. Is the goal already achieved in this situation?

C6_fifth_machine_prediction.note: this machine confirms the repaired sentence but does not discriminate it from the two one-bit candidates; the discriminating machine is the audit one

limits: witness situations are hypothetical and are not runs; the fourth and fifth machines are executed
the scripted user's bits come from the project's goal judge; a human would supply them
the repaired conjunction is expressible in this 244-term grammar; goals outside it are refused
the fifth machine is one environment: agreement there is evidence, not proof of all environments
no edit is composed and no program is repaired; this prices the sentence an edit is for
